posts.name: Christopher
posts.cooked:
Shhhh, leaking some knowledge here!

The first expansion will be called “Sentinels of the Multiverse: AGAIN!”

It will include Baron Blade’s Son, Citizen Dawn’s sister, Grand Warlord Voss’s second in command who took over after the defeat of Voss, and Omnitron’s wife.

The Environments will be A Different Base on Mars, and “Primal Island”, an island with prehistoric creatures and a volcano!

The Heroes are twins, joined at the hip, Named “Yin” and “Yan” who use their Dual Cartwheeling powers to fight crime!

Look forward to it!
